name: ChromaGrid-TS-TW
title: ChromaGrid
description: Six people cards sit in a neat grid, all greyscale at rest. Moving the pointer across them lifts the grey in a soft circular window, exposing each photo and its coloured card gradient.
use: A team or people grid should feel alive without video, extra images or a click.
avoid: It needs a pointer, so touch users only ever see the flat grey version of every card.
a11y: Each card is a clickable article with no tab stop, role or key handler, so the external links cannot be reached without a mouse. (keyboard: no, labels: partial, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Two rows of three rounded cards, each holding a square portrait above a name, an @handle on the right and a job title below. At rest every photo is grey and the gaps between cards read as near-black.
behaves: A circle of colour travels with the pointer, clearing the grey overlay only around the cursor. When the pointer leaves, the whole grid fades back to monochrome.
customise: Cards come from an items array of image, title, subtitle, handle, location, border colour, gradient and link; radius, damping, fade and easing are props.
weight: moderate: A full-cover backdrop-filter mask is repainted on every pointer move across six cards.
